jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM Mall of Asia
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This is position will be reporting to work at SM Mall of Asia. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Selling-Floor and Merchandise Standards Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and presentation of assigned selling areas. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ens

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description: Your Impact Areas 1. Achieve Sales Revenue Targets Lead the team to meet or exceed overall sales goals. Track sales performance and implement actions to close gaps. 2. Improve Opportunity-to-Win Conversion Rates Guide the team in effective prospecting, qualification, and deal closing. Monitor pipeline health and address obstacles impacting conversion. 3. Manage Individual and Team Quota Attainment Set clear quotas and review performance regularly. Provide coaching and support to ensure consistent achievement. 4. Develop and Execute Strategic Sales Plans Create and refine strategies based on data, customer insights, and market trends. Align team initiatives with core KPIs and organizational priorities. 5. Strengthen Customer Relationships Maintain high customer satisfaction and identify growth opportunities. Support the team in upselling, cross-selling, and retention efforts. 6. Coach and Develop the Sales Team Deliver ongoing training, mentoring, and performance feedback. Build a high-performance culture focused on continuous improvement. 7. Analyze Sales Data for Decision-Making Track KPIs such as revenue achievement, conversion rates, and quotas. Report insights that guide strategic and operational adjustments. 8. Collaborate Across Departments Work with marketing, operations, and other teams to support sales initiatives. Share market and customer feedback for product and service enhancement.

jobs.title: Retail Sales Associate
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Man the assigned store during scheduled operating hours. Work shifts may be adjusted from time to time depending on business requirements. Achieve the sales quota and other sales targets assigned to the store or individual. Maintain 100% familiarity with the products sold in-store, including product features, pricing, availability, promotions, and relevant collector or hobby information needed to assist customers. Actively engage mall or location foot traffic, invite potential customers to visit the store, understand their interests, and convert qualified traffic into customers. Build, update, and maintain an accurate customer database in accordance with company procedures and applicable privacy requirements. Ensure complete and accurate accounting of daily sales, payments, receipts, and other sales-related transactions. Conduct and document inventory counts at least once every week and promptly report any discrepancy, loss, damage, or stock concern. Keep the selling area, displays, merchandise, and customer-facing areas clean, organized, and presentable throughout the shift. Be ready and willing to be assigned or reassigned to different store locations within the assigned area when required by business needs. Perform other tasks that may be assigned from time to time.

jobs.title: Leasing Manager
jobs.description: Job Title: Leasing Manager (Restaurant Site Acquisition & Expansion) Industry: Restaurants, F&B and franchise brand expansion Brand Coverage: Hooters, Rock Shops, Scoozi, VK and future brands Salary: THB 35,000 per month + THB 10,000 per successfully leased location (commission) Destination Eats is seeking a proactive Leasing Manager to identify, evaluate and secure suitable restaurant premises for its brands. Based in Bangkok, the role will develop a pipeline of potential sites, negotiate commercial terms for management approval, and coordinate lease completion and handover. Each location must meet the relevant brand's customer, operational and financial requirements. Key Job Responsibilities: Source suitable locations: Identify opportunities through landlords, shopping-centre leasing teams, developers and property agents. Build a pipeline aligned with brand requirements and approved expansion priorities. Assess site suitability: Evaluate catchment, visibility, access, competition and delivery potential. Coordinate checks on restaurant use, kitchen and utility requirements, exhaust, drainage, grease management and signage. Prepare commercial proposals: Work with Operations and Finance on site proposals and occupancy-cost comparisons, including rent, service charges, fit-out requirements and other financial commitments. Negotiate lease terms: Negotiate rent, escalation, lease duration, rent-free and fit-out periods, renewal options, operating conditions and other terms for management approval. Coordinate approvals and completion: Work with Operations, Finance, Legal and Projects on due diligence, required brand or franchisor approvals, lease documentation, execution, and site handover. Manage relationships and reporting: Maintain an accurate site pipeline and weekly progress updates. Build landlord relationships and support existing-site lease matters, renewals and renegotiations as assigned.
